sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite their league-leading position, Sandbach come into this fixture on the back of a recent loss, though their overall form remains strong with seven wins in their last six outings. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are winless in their last five games, making this an opportunity for Sandbach to bounce back immediately.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a mid-table clash between sides with contrasting recent form—Bridgnorth have won their last two despite two losses beforehand, while Eccleshall are on a strong run of four consecutive victories. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, visit Wednesfield Community on Saturday before hosting Brereton Social on Wednesday evening, a potentially decisive midweek fixture for both sides. Bilston Town (5th) host Foley Meir in a contest between mid-table sides, while in-form Barnton travel to face Shawbury United, who are mired in a six-game losing streak. New Mills, unbeaten in their last game, host Market Drayton Town on Saturday, with both sides looking to climb out of the lower reaches. The remaining fixtures see Crewe entertain Allscott Heath, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town, and Brereton Social host struggling Widnes Town at the start of the weekend—all contests involving clubs in the lower half of the table battling for points.
